title: There Are No Dreams in Looking Back

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: So, what did you want to talk about?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
...Word reached me that you have been flatly rejecting countless scouting offers.
Despite repeated warnings from the instructors, your stance remains unchanged.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
......
You're being pretty boring today, Rudolf.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I understand that you find this sort of counsel immensely bothersome.
However, in my position, I have duties to uphold.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Without an assigned Trainer, you cannot make your debut.
...Should this continue, it may be deemed a refusal to race, leading to expulsion.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
...Seeing an umamusume with such boundless potential standing still
is a personal concern of mine as well. At the very least, tell me your reason.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: A reason, huh...

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
...... It's not like I don't want a Trainer, honestly.
I just haven't met anyone who clicks.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
I just can't bring myself to see the value in glory.
Not in 'GⅠ victories,' and not in the legendary 'Classic Triple Crown.'

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
I have no desire to fulfill what they want from me.
I couldn't walk that path with them.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
And forcing them to bend to my way of doing things feels wrong, too.
So we just end up going in circles.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: ...Think I'm as stubborn as ever?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: No, I simply think it is very like you.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
...Perhaps you should try shifting your perspective, C.B.
One's values... do not necessarily need to align as rigidly as you think.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I think a Trainer is someone who possesses what
can never come from an Umamusume alone.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: *pant, pant, pant, pant...*

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
(......
...Why can't I just run in races all by myself?)

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: (I never did fit in with everyone else, ever since I was little.)

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
(The schoolyard during a downpour looked so bright and sparkling.
I was having so much fun, just running around lost in the moment—until they scolded me.)

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
(They got mad when I wore a tracksuit to school because uniforms felt too tight,
and when the blue sky felt so nice that I skipped class to take a walk, they got mad at that too.)

text_block_list.name: School Teacher
text_block_list.text: ...Hey, why can't you just listen to your teacher?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
(Even when told to look right, I couldn't bring myself to do it unless it made sense to me.
What felt natural to me always seemed to make enemies.)

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: (Skipping school, completely at a loss for what to do... Then, one day—)

text_block_list.name: Young C.B.
text_block_list.text:
...Huh? You're short a runner and want me to join?
I've... never run in a real race before, though... Are you sure?)

text_block_list.name: Young C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, the starting gate is pretty cramped!
So once this opens, that's the start—)

text_block_list.name: Young C.B.
text_block_list.text: ing...—

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
(I still remember it so vividly. The very moment that narrow gate flew open,
and the lush green turf welcomed every piece of who I was.)

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: (I knew right then that I'd found the freest place in the whole world.)

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: *pant, gasp... haaah...*

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
...And right after that, I joined a racing club, didn't I?
I was so full of excitement. ...Even if it didn't work out in the end.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
...Tracen Academy, home of the pinnacle of racing.
I thought maybe here, I'd find a way to run freely, but...

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: ...Why is it that everyone else can run for the sake of something?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After finishing some shopping in town, it had gotten late,
so I was hurrying on my way back when—

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Ugh...
